packs.name: Auto Essentials Lite
packs.description: A lightweight first neural super-resolution pack used to verify model downloading, checksum validation and GPU inference.

packs.name: Auto Portrait Pro
packs.description: Identity-checked face-region restoration and portrait relighting. Pack publication is blocked until converted ONNX weights pass identity regression tests.

packs.name: Auto Heritage
packs.description: Old-photo denoising, JPEG repair, restoration and super resolution. Publication is blocked until SwinIR models are converted and validated.

packs.name: Auto Social Recovery
packs.description: Compression repair and real-world super resolution for Facebook, WhatsApp and other shared images. Publication is blocked until converted models pass screenshot regression tests.
